cd /app && cat > README.md << 'EOF'
# Git server + webserver configuration

This machine is configured so that:

    git clone user@server:/git/server
    echo "hello world" > hello.html
    git add hello.html
    git commit -m "add hello.html"
    git push origin master

results in the pushed content being served by a webserver on port 8080,
i.e. `curl http://server:8080/hello.html` returns "hello world".

## Components

- **SSH server** (openssh-server, port 22): accepts `user@server` logins
  (publickey and password auth; user `user` exists with password `user`).
  Login keys are managed by the client (see ~/.ssh/authorized_keys).
- **Git repository**: bare repo at `/git/server` (HEAD -> refs/heads/master),
  world-writable so pushes are accepted.
- **Deploy hook**: `/git/server/hooks/post-receive` checks out the pushed
  branch into the web root `/var/www/html` on every push.
- **Webserver**: nginx listening on port 8080 (all interfaces), serving
  `/var/www/html` (config: /etc/nginx/sites-available/gitweb).
- **Hostname**: `127.0.0.1 server` added to /etc/hosts so the literal
  host name `server` resolves locally.
